rationale: Archive Nokomis Energy from the manager-level North American PortCo list and retire the unsupported Apollo ownership period. Great Bay Renewables' June 2024 transaction was royalty financing through a separate Nokomis Bay LLC structure: Great Bay received Class R units in that royalty holding company, project-level gross-revenue royalties, and unexercised warrants that could permit a future acquisition of up to 10% of Nokomis Energy. No reviewed source establishes exercise of those warrants or current direct Apollo ownership of Nokomis Energy. Apollo's upstream funds then sold their direct 50% interest in Great Bay to Northampton Capital Partners on July 30, 2026. Nokomis and Great Bay remain distinct companies, so no canonical merge or redirect is appropriate. The database retains Nokomis as an archived historical record and preserves its relations, while the approved archive overlay removes it from the evaluated seed list.

beforeImage.name: Nokomis Energy
beforeImage.description: Nokomis Energy develops and owns distributed solar projects connected to local distribution grids in the United States. Its end markets include community solar programs, local power purchasers, and other distributed-energy counterparties, and the business follows an asset-heavy development-to-own model. Public materials tied to Great Bay Renewables' 2024 investment describe a 77-project solar portfolio across seven U.S. states, with activity focused on distributed generation markets. The disclosed transaction was structured as growth capital to support construction and expansion rather than as a publicly detailed sale of control. Great Bay Renewables announced a $30 million investment in August 2024, and Great Bay is jointly controlled by Altius Renewable Royalties and Apollo-affiliated funds, while public sources do not disclose Nokomis's broader ownership split.

afterImage.name: Nokomis Energy
afterImage.description: Nokomis Energy, LLC is a Minneapolis-based distributed-solar developer founded in 2017. Great Bay Renewables closed a royalty-financing transaction in June 2024 through Nokomis Bay LLC, a separate holding company jointly held by Great Bay and Nokomis. Great Bay received Class R units in that royalty structure, project-level gross-revenue royalties, and unexercised warrants permitting a future acquisition of up to 10% of Nokomis Energy. Reviewed public sources do not establish exercise of the warrants or current direct Apollo ownership of Nokomis Energy. Apollo-managed funds sold their upstream 50% Great Bay interest to Northampton Capital Partners on July 30, 2026. Because the manager exposure was indirect royalty financing rather than direct company ownership, Nokomis is excluded from the manager-level PortCo census.
